column2: Once again, on the following day, the remembrance of Gopaal's place awakened in the heart of His Holiness Gaur Govinda Swami Maharaj.
How he offered heartfelt prayers at the lotus feet of the Lord to fulfill that divine longing, can be seen from his diary as follows.
Oh Lord... what You are doing, only You know.
This servant is unable to understand anything.
This servant is just like a machine in Your hands.
What You want to accomplish through this servant, You know it well.
Whatever is Your plan for this servant, You know it very well.
Anyhow, this servant has a strong desire, You know about his Gopaal's place.
This servant has developed a desire to open a branch of ISKCON at Gadeigiri, the place of Gopaal, to teach and preach about the Bhagavad Gita to the devotees present there.
At present, Gopaal's place is in a very wretched condition.
How can we develop this place?
People in general are forgetting Gopaal, how can they once again remember Gopaal and get involved in the development of this place, along with performing shravan and kirtan there?

There is a strong desire in the heart of this servant, once an ISKCON centre is opened at Bhubaneswar, this servant desires to stay there permanently, and then, to establish Gopaal's place as one of its branch centers.
Oh Lord... Kindly shower Your mercy and make this successful.
Oh my Lord, Gopaal... please shower Your mercy.
May this servant achieve Krishna prema along with proper devotee association, well-wishers and companions.
May this servant achieve success in the service of Shri Shri Guru and Gauranga.
